analyst.summary: R R Kabel had an exceptionally strong quarter -- revenue up 54% and profit up 129% -- driven by real volume growth in its core wires-and-cables business plus a first-time operational breakeven in its smaller fans-and-appliances division. The improvement looks genuine (driven by efficiency, not just copper prices), but the stock's ~55x earnings multiple already reflects a good deal of that good news. We rate it a Hold: real momentum, but priced for it.
